A motion to fund the garden was tabled until the April session pending a survey of nearby households. The secretary read correspondence from the city council regarding sidewalk repairs on Oak Avenue, and the traffic committee summarized its meeting with the county engineer about the crosswalk near the elementary school. Volunteers signed up for the spring cleanup day, the food drive, and the youth tutoring program. After announcements about the summer festival, the block captains gave brief updates on membership dues, newsletter delivery, and the emergency contact list. With no further business and the clock approaching midnight, the tired committee adjourned shortly after midnight.
